title: Claude Code work log
description: What each Claude Code session did, as tables: sessions, prompts, tool calls, edits, subagents and setup, with click-through from a session to its prompts and from a prompt to its actions.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Applies only to the Prometheus columns in Sessions (Tokens, Cost, Lines, Models); the Loki-based tables (API calls, prompt, skill and workflow cost and tokens) ignore it.

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.description: Claude Code session (session.id). Set by clicking a session in Sessions; All = every session.

list.name: prompt
list.label: Prompt
list.description: prompt_id; .* = all. Set by clicking a prompt/turn.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: One row per Claude Code session with telemetry in the time range. Started and Last event are the first and last Loki event in the range; Span is the time between them and Active is Claude Code's active time. Tokens, Cost and Lines added/removed honour Model and come from Prometheus (tokens include advisor-model tokens, so they exceed the sum of prompt Tokens); Commits, Edits and Active also come from Prometheus. Prompts, API calls and Tool calls come from Loki and ignore Model. The table ignores Session and Prompt. Click a Session to drill into it: it sets Session, resets Prompt to .* and narrows the time range to that session. Above about 1000 sessions in the range the panel fails with a Loki series-limit error: narrow the time range.

targets.expr: group by (session_id, host_name, user_email, persona, service_version, terminal_type) (last_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "host_name", "-", "", ""), "user_email", "-", "", ""), "persona", "-", "", ""), "service_version", "-", "", ""), "terminal_type", "-", "", "")

group by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "model", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id, k) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "cost", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "tokens", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "active", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_commit_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "commits", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model", type="added"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "lines_added", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model", type="removed"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "lines_removed", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", decision="accept"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "edits_accept", "", "") or label_replace(increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", decision="reject"}[$__range] anchored), "k", "edits_reject", "", "")) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "k", "-", "", "")

min by (session_id, host_name) (min_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | session_id!="" | user_email=~"$user" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "host_name", "-", "", "")

max by (session_id) (max_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | session_id!="" | user_email=~"$user" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id, user_email, persona, service_version, terminal_type) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | session_id!="" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "user_email", "-", "", ""), "persona", "-", "", ""), "service_version", "-", "", ""), "terminal_type", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="user_prompt" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | success!="true" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", "")

targets.expression:
SELECT
  ids.session_id AS `Session`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(st.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Started`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(en.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Last event`,
  (en.__value__ - st.__value__) / 1000 AS `Span`,
  COALESCE(a.host_name, st.host_name) AS `VM`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.user_email, ''), NULLIF(li.user_email, ''), '(none)') AS `User`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.persona, ''), NULLIF(li.persona, ''), '(none)') AS `Persona`,
  COALESCE(m.models, '') AS `Models`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.service_version, ''), li.service_version, '') AS `Version`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.terminal_type, ''), li.terminal_type, '') AS `Terminal`,
  COALESCE(lp.__value__, 0) AS `Prompts`,
  COALESCE(la.__value__, 0) AS `API calls`,
  COALESCE(lt.__value__, 0) AS `Tool calls`,
  COALESCE(lf.__value__, 0) AS `Failed tools`,
  COALESCE(n.tokens, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  COALESCE(n.cost, 0) AS `Cost`,
  COALESCE(n.commits, 0) AS `Commits`,
  COALESCE(n.lines_added, 0) AS `Lines added`,
  COALESCE(n.lines_removed, 0) AS `Lines removed`,
  COALESCE(n.edits_accepted, 0) AS `Edits accepted`,
  COALESCE(n.edits_rejected, 0) AS `Edits rejected`,
  COALESCE(n.active_s, 0) AS `Active`,
  CAST(CAST(st.__value__ AS SIGNED) - 60000 AS CHAR) AS start_ms,
  CAST(CAST(en.__value__ AS SIGNED) + 60000 AS CHAR) AS end_ms,
  ids.session_id AS session_id
FROM (SELECT session_id FROM A UNION SELECT session_id FROM LS) ids
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, MAX(host_name) AS host_name, MAX(user_email) AS user_email, MAX(persona) AS persona,
                  MAX(service_version) AS service_version, MAX(terminal_type) AS terminal_type
           FROM A GROUP BY session_id) a ON a.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, MAX(NULLIF(user_email, '')) AS user_email, MAX(NULLIF(persona, '')) AS persona,
                  MAX(NULLIF(service_version, '')) AS service_version, MAX(NULLIF(terminal_type, '')) AS terminal_type
           FROM LI GROUP BY session_id) li ON li.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LS st ON st.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LE en ON en.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT model ORDER BY model SEPARATOR ', ') AS models
           FROM M GROUP BY session_id) m ON m.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT session_id,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'cost' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS cost,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'tokens' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS tokens,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'active' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS active_s,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'commits' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS commits,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'lines_added' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS lines_added,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'lines_removed' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS lines_removed,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'edits_accept' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS edits_accepted,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'edits_reject' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS edits_rejected
           FROM N GROUP BY session_id) n ON n.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LP lp ON lp.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LA la ON la.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LT lt ON lt.session_id = ids.session_id
LEFT JOIN LF lf ON lf.session_id = ids.session_id
WHERE ids.session_id <> '-'
ORDER BY `Started` DESC

panels.title: Prompts
panels.description: One row per user prompt (prompt_id) in the time range, for the selected Session (All = every prompt in the range; above about 500 prompts the panel fails with a Loki series-limit error, so pick a session). All columns come from Loki and ignore Model and Prompt: Command is the slash command (empty for a typed prompt), Prompt length is in characters, Tokens and Cost are summed from the prompt's api_request events (Tokens exclude advisor-model tokens, which only Prometheus counts), Tool calls and Failed tools come from tool_result, Subagents from subagent_completed, and Work span is the first to last api_request/tool_result/assistant_response/subagent_completed/compaction of the prompt, including background subagents. Click a Prompt to select it (and its session) for the panels below; set Prompt back to .* to clear it. Click a Trace to open the prompt's trace in Tempo.

targets.expr: max by (session_id, prompt_id, trace_id, command_name, prompt_length) (max_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="user_prompt" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_id", "-", "", ""), "prompt_id", "-", "", ""), "trace_id", "-", "", ""), "command_name", "-", "", ""), "prompt_length", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id, model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", ""), "model", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format tok=`{{ add .input_tokens .output_tokens .cache_read_tokens .cache_creation_tokens }}` | unwrap tok | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id, success) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" [$__range])) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", ""), "success", "-", "", "")

sum by (prompt_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

min by (prompt_id) (min_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"api_request|tool_result|assistant_response|subagent_completed|compaction" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

max by (prompt_id) (max_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"api_request|tool_result|assistant_response|subagent_completed|compaction" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | label_format ts=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpochMillis }}` | unwrap ts | __error__="" [$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "prompt_id", "-", "", "")

targets.expression:
SELECT
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(p.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Time`,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.command_name, '') IN ('', '-') THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('/', p.command_name) END AS `Command`,
  CAST(NULLIF(p.prompt_length, '') AS SIGNED) AS `Prompt length`,
  COALESCE(m.models, '') AS `Models`,
  COALESCE(m.api_calls, 0) AS `API calls`,
  COALESCE(k.__value__, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  COALESCE(c.__value__, 0) AS `Cost`,
  COALESCE(t.tool_calls, 0) AS `Tool calls`,
  COALESCE(t.failed_tool_calls, 0) AS `Failed tools`,
  COALESCE(s.__value__, 0) AS `Subagents`,
  CASE WHEN e.__value__ >= f.__value__ THEN (e.__value__ - f.__value__) / 1000 ELSE 0 END AS `Work span`,
  SUBSTRING(p.prompt_id, 1, 8) AS `Prompt`,
  p.trace_id AS `Trace`,
  p.prompt_id AS prompt_id,
  p.session_id AS session_id
FROM P p
LEFT JOIN (SELECT prompt_id, SUM(__value__) AS api_calls,
                  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT model ORDER BY model SEPARATOR ', ') AS models
           FROM PM GROUP BY prompt_id) m ON m.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN PC c ON c.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN PK k ON k.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT prompt_id, SUM(__value__) AS tool_calls,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(success, '') <> 'true' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tool_calls
           FROM PT GROUP BY prompt_id) t ON t.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN PS s ON s.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN PF f ON f.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
LEFT JOIN PE e ON e.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
WHERE p.prompt_id <> '-'
ORDER BY p.__value__ DESC

panels.title: Tool summary
panels.description: One row per tool for the selected Session and Prompt, from Loki tool_result events (ignores Model). Success is the share of calls with success=true; Avg and Total duration come from duration_ms; Input and Output size are the summed tool_input_size_bytes / tool_result_size_bytes. By config / By user / By other count the calls by permission decision_source: config = allowed by settings or permission mode, user = a user decision (user_temporary, user_permanent, ...), other = anything else (hook, ...) or no decision.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range]))

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | success!="true" [$__range])) or sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range])) * 0

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | success="true" [$__range])) / sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range])) or sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range])) * 0

avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (tool_name) or sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range])) * 0

sum by (tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | unwrap tool_input_size_bytes | __error__="" [$__range])) or sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range])) * 0

sum by (tool_name) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | unwrap tool_result_size_bytes | __error__="" [$__range])) or sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range])) * 0

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | decision_source="config" [$__range])) or sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" [$__range])) * 0

panels.title: Shell commands
panels.description: One row per program (argv[0], e.g. git, sed, python) and command class run through the Bash tool, with the number of calls, from claude_code.tool trace spans in Tempo (TraceQL metrics). Follows VM, User, Environment (spans without an environment always match) and Session; ignores Prompt (spans carry no prompt_id) and Model. Spans without user.email are dropped by the User filter. Full command (span.full_command) appears only when the agents run with OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Then each distinct command line is its own row and Calls counts runs of that exact text; spans recorded without it keep an empty Full command. Tempo keeps the first 2 KB of a command (distributor max_attribute_bytes). Tempo answers TraceQL metrics for at most 14 days (query_frontend.metrics.max_duration in tempo.yaml); longer ranges show an error here.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "claude-code" && resource.host.name =~ "${host:pipe}" && span.user.email =~ "${user:pipe}" && (resource.deployment.environment.name =~ "${env:pipe}" || resource.deployment.environment.name = nil) && span.session.id =~ "${session:regex}" && span.bash_argv0 != nil } | count_over_time() by (span.bash_argv0, span.bash_command_class, span.full_command)

panels.title: Code edits
panels.description: Edit/Write/NotebookEdit permission decisions for the selected Session, per file language, tool, decision and decision source, from the Prometheus counter claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total. Counts tool calls, not files or lines. The metric has no model or prompt label, so the table ignores Model and Prompt; lines added/removed per model are in Sessions.

targets.expr: sum by (language, tool_name, decision, source) (increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range] anchored)) > 0

panels.title: Skills
panels.description: One row per skill for the selected Session and Prompt: the API requests made while the skill ran, with their cost and tokens (input + output + cache), from the skill_name on Loki api_request events (ignores Model). API requests are used because skill_activated reports custom skills as "custom_skill", while api_request carries the real skill name.

targets.expression:
SELECT
  r.`VM` AS `VM`,
  r.`Persona` AS `Persona`,
  COUNT(*) AS `Runs`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.session_id) AS `Sessions`,
  SUM(r.`Run time`) AS `Run time`,
  SUM(r.`API calls`) AS `API calls`,
  SUM(r.`Tool calls`) AS `Tool calls`,
  SUM(r.`Failed tools`) AS `Failed tools`,
  SUM(r.`Tokens`) AS `Tokens`,
  SUM(r.`Cost`) AS `Cost`,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(MAX(r.started_ms) / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Last run`
FROM (SELECT
  s.__value__ AS started_ms,
  CAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(s.__value__ / 1000)) AS DATETIME) AS `Started`,
  CASE WHEN e.__value__ >= s.__value__ THEN (e.__value__ - s.__value__) / 1000 ELSE 0 END AS `Run time`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(i.host_name, ''), '(none)') AS `VM`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(i.persona, ''), '(none)') AS `Persona`,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(i.user_email, ''), '(none)') AS `User`,
  COALESCE(i.workflow_name, '') AS `Workflow`,
  s.workflow_run_id AS `Run`,
  COALESCE(a.models, '') AS `Models`,
  COALESCE(a.api_calls, 0) AS `API calls`,
  COALESCE(k.__value__, 0) AS `Tokens`,
  COALESCE(c.__value__, 0) AS `Cost`,
  COALESCE(t.tool_calls, 0) AS `Tool calls`,
  COALESCE(t.failed_tool_calls, 0) AS `Failed tools`,
  SUBSTRING(i.session_id, 1, 8) AS `Session`,
  SUBSTRING(fp.prompt_id, 1, 8) AS `Prompt`,
  i.session_id AS session_id,
  fp.prompt_id AS prompt_id,
  CAST(CAST(s.__value__ AS SIGNED) - 60000 AS CHAR) AS start_ms,
  CAST(CAST(e.__value__ AS SIGNED) + 60000 AS CHAR) AS end_ms
FROM WS s
JOIN (SELECT workflow_run_id, MAX(workflow_name) AS workflow_name, MAX(session_id) AS session_id,
             MAX(host_name) AS host_name, MAX(persona) AS persona, MAX(user_email) AS user_email
      FROM WI GROUP BY workflow_run_id) i ON i.workflow_run_id = s.workflow_run_id
LEFT JOIN WE e ON e.workflow_run_id = s.workflow_run_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT workflow_run_id, SUM(__value__) AS api_calls,
                  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT model ORDER BY model SEPARATOR ', ') AS models
           FROM WA GROUP BY workflow_run_id) a ON a.workflow_run_id = s.workflow_run_id
LEFT JOIN WC c ON c.workflow_run_id = s.workflow_run_id
LEFT JOIN WK k ON k.workflow_run_id = s.workflow_run_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT workflow_run_id, SUM(__value__) AS tool_calls,
                  SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(success, '') <> 'true' THEN __value__ ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tool_calls
           FROM WT GROUP BY workflow_run_id) t ON t.workflow_run_id = s.workflow_run_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT workflow_run_id, prompt_id
           FROM (SELECT workflow_run_id, prompt_id,
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_run_id ORDER BY __value__) AS rn
                 FROM WP WHERE prompt_id <> '-') x
           WHERE rn = 1) fp ON fp.workflow_run_id = s.workflow_run_id
WHERE s.workflow_run_id <> '-') r
GROUP BY r.`VM`, r.`Persona`
ORDER BY `Cost` DESC

value.title: Drill into this run's session (time range = the run)

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: One row per tool call (Loki tool_result event) for the selected Session and Prompt (ignores Model), newest first: tool, success and error type, duration, input/output size, permission decision and its source, and the Workflow it ran in ("custom" for user-defined workflows). Command (full_command from tool_parameters), File (file_path from tool_input) and Input (the raw tool_input JSON: URLs, patterns, MCP arguments) appear only when the agents run with OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1. Claude Code shortens long strings in tool_input and cuts it at about 4 KB; a cut value is not valid JSON, so File stays empty and Input shows the start. Hover a long cell and click the eye icon for the full value. Shows the newest 5000 tool calls; narrow the time range or pick a session or prompt for older ones. Click a Prompt to select it, or a Trace to open the prompt's trace in Tempo.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session" | prompt_id=~"$prompt" | label_format prompt_short=`{{ trunc 8 .prompt_id }}`

panels.title: Plugins loaded
panels.description: One row per plugin loaded at session start (Loki plugin_loaded): marketplace, scope, how it was enabled, whether it brings hooks or an MCP server, and how many skill/command/agent paths it adds. Third-party plugin names are reported as "third-party". Follows VM, User and Session; ignores Prompt (these are session-start events) and Model. Shows the newest 5000.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="plugin_loaded" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session"

panels.title: MCP server connections
panels.description: One row per MCP server connection attempt (Loki mcp_server_connection): scope, transport, connected or failed (with the error code), connect time and whether a plugin provides it. The event carries no server name. Only reconnects carry a prompt_id. Follows VM, User and Session; ignores Prompt (these are session-start events) and Model. Shows the newest 5000.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="mcp_server_connection" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session"

panels.title: Hooks registered
panels.description: One row per hook registered at session start (Loki hook_registered): the hook event it runs on, its type and where it is configured. The hook command is not reported. Follows VM, User and Session; ignores Prompt (these are session-start events) and Model. Shows the newest 5000.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="hook_registered" | user_email=~"$user" | session_id=~"$session"

Follows VM, User and Session; ignores Prompt (these are session-start events) and Model. Shows the newest 5000.
